subject: Inputting External File into Skyline For MSSTATS

messages.author: 5c2fbc7caf32c830
messages.subject: Inputting External File into Skyline For MSSTATS
parts:
I'm wondering if it is possible to trick Skyline to input an external excel or csv file to run MSSTATS on. Has anyone tried this successfully? 

Thanks!

-Aaron

messages.author: 99540594784b9805
messages.subject: Re: Inputting External File into Skyline For MSSTATS
parts:
I don't think you would want to have Skyline involved at all if you had your own CSV file.

The MSstats external tool in Skyline just calls in the MSstats R package.  Many people who want more control over MSstats settings run R themselves and call the "groupComparison" function.
